_comment: Agent-Native tool manifest. Every capability Apex exposes, with safety classification.

safety_levels.read: No writes. Reads log files or APIs and returns analysis only.
safety_levels.write-log: Writes JSON to logs/ only. No external API calls that cause side effects.
safety_levels.external-fetch: Fetches from external APIs (Yahoo, FRED, T212 read-only). Writes to logs/.
safety_levels.execute-signal: May write to apex-trade-queue.json or apex-pending-signal.json. No orders placed.
safety_levels.execute-trade: Calls Trading 212 API to place, modify, or cancel orders. Requires explicit approval.

tools.name: query-positions
tools.description: Current open positions: ticker, qty, entry, current price, P&L, stop, signal type. Also portfolio cash and total value.

tools.name: query-regime
tools.description: Current market regime: CLEAR/CAUTION/RISK_OFF, VIX, breadth, circuit breaker, size multiplier, market direction.

tools.name: query-signals
tools.description: Pending signal (if any), EV verdict, and trade queue contents.

tools.name: query-health
tools.description: System health: circuit breaker blocks, drawdown status, data integrity check results, recent health log.

tools.name: query-autopilot
tools.description: Autopilot state: enabled/paused, trades today vs limit, daily loss, total autonomous trades, recent log.

tools.name: query-performance
tools.description: Performance metrics: Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, closed trades, total P&L, drawdown, benchmark vs SPY.

tools.name: query-learning
tools.description: Current learned state: Bayesian layer weights, edge proof verdicts per signal type, trajectory insights, Kelly fraction.

tools.name: query-schedule
tools.description: Upcoming scheduled jobs in the next 2 hours, with chain associations and categories.

tools.name: regime-check
tools.description: Checks VIX level and market breadth to classify the current market regime (RISK_ON / RISK_OFF / CAUTION).

tools.name: regime-hmm
tools.description: HMM 3-state regime detection. Identifies TRENDING/MEAN_REVERTING/CRISIS latent state from SPY returns + VIX changes. Supplements rule-based regime scaling.

tools.name: regime-scaling
tools.description: Calculates position size scaling factors based on current regime, VIX, and drawdown state.

tools.name: drawdown-check
tools.description: Computes peak-to-trough drawdown from portfolio history. Updates apex-portfolio-peak.json.

tools.name: circuit-breaker
tools.description: Checks whether any circuit breaker conditions are triggered (max drawdown, daily loss limit, error rate).

tools.name: market-direction
tools.description: Determines overall market direction (bull/bear/neutral) using SPY/QQQ trend analysis.

tools.name: breadth-thrust
tools.description: Calculates advance/decline breadth thrust indicator for market health assessment.

tools.name: breadth-drilldown
tools.description: Sector-level breadth breakdown — which sectors are leading/lagging.

tools.name: vix-correlation
tools.description: Computes VIX-to-portfolio correlation to gauge systemic risk exposure.

tools.name: sector-rotation
tools.description: Identifies leading and lagging sectors using relative strength momentum.

tools.name: geo-news
tools.description: Fetches and scores geopolitical news events for macro risk flags.

tools.name: macro-signals
tools.description: Fetches FRED macro indicators (yield curve, unemployment, CPI) and scores macro environment.

tools.name: sentiment
tools.description: Runs VADER NLP sentiment scoring on financial news headlines for portfolio holdings.

tools.name: fundamentals
tools.description: Fetches and scores fundamental data (PE, EPS growth, quality metrics) for universe.

tools.name: fundamental-signals
tools.description: Converts raw fundamental data into scored trading signals.

tools.name: insider-data
tools.description: Fetches EDGAR insider trading filings and scores for bullish/bearish clusters.

tools.name: sec-filing-risk
tools.description: Layer 20: Fetches recent SEC EDGAR filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q) per ticker. Flags going concern, bankruptcy, restatement, auditor departure, late filings, mass officer departures. Score penalties -1 to -3. 24h TTL cache.

tools.name: options-flow
tools.description: Analyses options flow for unusual call/put activity as a leading indicator.

tools.name: multiframe
tools.description: Multi-timeframe confirmation: checks daily/weekly/monthly trend alignment per ticker.

tools.name: relative-strength
tools.description: Ranks portfolio holdings and watchlist by relative strength vs SPY.

tools.name: watchlist-analyzer
tools.description: Scores all tickers in the watchlist universe using the 18-layer scoring system.

tools.name: contrarian-scan
tools.description: Scans for oversold tickers meeting contrarian entry criteria (RSI, volume, regime).

tools.name: inverse-scanner
tools.description: Scans inverse ETF universe for signals during RISK_OFF regime.

tools.name: earnings-drift
tools.description: Identifies post-earnings drift setups using earnings surprise + momentum.

tools.name: dividend-capture
tools.description: Finds dividend capture opportunities (ex-date within window, quality filter).

tools.name: expected-value
tools.description: Calculates Bayesian EV for a pending signal. Requires apex-pending-signal.json to exist.

tools.name: staleness-check
tools.description: Checks age of all log files and prices to detect stale data before acting on signals.

tools.name: data-integrity
tools.description: Runs 6 cross-validation checks: positions vs T212, stop prices, FX consistency, etc.

tools.name: layer-audit
tools.description: Audits the 18 scoring layers for multicollinearity and redundancy discounts.

tools.name: weight-optimizer
tools.description: Updates Bayesian Beta posteriors for each scoring layer based on closed trade outcomes.

tools.name: trajectory-learner
tools.description: Mines completed trade trajectories for hold-time and R patterns. Updates early-cut thresholds.

tools.name: edge-proof
tools.description: Runs significance tests (p-value, WR, n) per signal type. Activates scoring bonuses/penalties.

tools.name: score-adapter
tools.description: Recalculates global and per-bucket score adjustment factors from recent performance.

tools.name: taco-classifier
tools.description: TACO: classifies VIX spike events as genuine fear vs policy walkback pattern.

tools.name: taco-monitor
tools.description: TACO state machine: monitors for walkback signal and updates phase (FEAR/WATCHING/WALKBACK).

tools.name: taco-signal-injector
tools.description: TACO: injects buy signals when walkback is confirmed. Writes to trade queue.

tools.name: safe-haven
tools.description: Scans for safe-haven instruments (gold, bonds, VIX ETFs) during RISK_OFF regime.

tools.name: kelly-v2
tools.description: Uncertainty-aware Kelly criterion sizing with regime scaling and slippage adjustment.

tools.name: vwap-gate
tools.description: Checks whether current price is above/below VWAP for intraday entry quality gate.

tools.name: blackswan-test
tools.description: Stress-tests portfolio against black swan scenarios (2008, 2020, flash crash).

tools.name: shaw-test
tools.description: D.E. Shaw-style stat arb check: mean-reversion z-score across portfolio pairs.

tools.name: simons-test
tools.description: Renaissance-style factor test: checks for pattern significance across recent signals.

tools.name: backtest-v2
tools.description: Walk-forward backtest with transaction costs. Produces Sharpe, max DD, win rate.

tools.name: mae-mfe
tools.description: Maximum Adverse/Favourable Excursion analysis to calibrate stop and target placement.

tools.name: sharpe
tools.description: Computes rolling Sharpe ratio and Sortino ratio from closed trade history.

tools.name: reconcile
tools.description: Reconciles local apex-positions.json against live T212 portfolio. Flags any divergence.

tools.name: broker-watchdog
tools.description: Checks all open positions have valid stop orders in T212. Replaces missing stops.

tools.name: trailing-stop
tools.description: Updates trailing stops for all open positions based on ATR and trajectory rules.

tools.name: universe-validator
tools.description: Validates all tickers in the universe against Yahoo Finance. Flags delisted/renamed.

tools.name: learning-digest
tools.description: Produces a human-readable digest of what the system has learned from recent trades.

tools.name: rolling-pnl
tools.description: Computes opportunity cost of held positions vs SPY benchmark over the same period.

tools.name: opportunity-cost
tools.description: EOD review of blocked signals: evaluates what price did vs entry, computes per-gate false positive rate, alerts if a gate is blocking >50% winners (n>=5, 30-day window).

tools.name: agent-tighten-stop
tools.description: One-directional stop tightening. Can ONLY move stops closer to current price (tighter), never farther. Safe for autonomous agent use. Args: <t212_ticker> <new_stop_price>.

tools.name: intraday-momentum
tools.description: Intraday momentum analysis for all open positions. Per-position: RSI(15m), VWAP deviation, volume trend, distance to targets, session high/low, R-multiple. Verdict: STRONG/NEUTRAL/FADING/EXHAUSTED.

tools.name: agent-ledger
tools.description: Agent Economic Value Ledger. Joins apex-agent-actions against closed-trade outcomes to compute £ P&L impact of every logged action, minus LLM cost, over a lookback window. Answers 'did the agent make us money?' with a single number. Flags each attribution with confidence (high/medium/low/none) and method — transparent about uncertainty.

tools.name: agent-baseline
tools.description: Null-agent counterfactual P&L. Computes realised_pnl minus what the book would have done if the agent had stayed silent, i.e. α. Publishes realised, null-baseline, gross α, net α (after LLM cost), and an 'additive/neutral/subtractive' verdict.

tools.name: agent-calibration
tools.description: Brier score + calibration curve. Joins the ledger's attributed actions against self-reported confidence and asks: when the agent says 0.9, is it right 9 times in 10? Reports overall Brier, per-bucket hit rate, and a diagnosis (well_calibrated / acceptable / poorly_calibrated, plus overconfidence drift).

tools.name: agent-tier
tools.description: Tiered authority evaluator. Reads ledger + baseline + calibration; emits tier in {Probation, Standard, Senior} with capability flags. apex-agent.py gates close_position and related destructive actions on this file. Demotion is automatic on 3 consecutive losers, 30d α < 0, or brier > 0.30.

tools.name: close-position
tools.description: Market-close an open T212 position. Cancels working stop, places market sell for full quantity, marks position as closing. Refuses when venue is closed. Requires --confirm flag; the tool runner will block unless invoked with --force.

tools.name: sync-gates
tools.description: Publish current decision thresholds from apex_config.py into apex-decision-gates.json for agent inspection. Covers circuit breaker levels, position sizing, signal quality gates, hold periods, ATR stops, and LLM budget.

tools.name: build-context
tools.description: Rebuild the session-bootstrap context doc (apex-context.md). Composes market status, regime, positions, signals, recent agent actions, track record, decision gates, and available tools into a single markdown file the agent reads at session start.
